provider: Qdrant Cloud Inference (free models on a free cluster)
category: embedding inference inside a vector database cluster, free models with no stated token cap

free_tier.stated: BM25 and a dense model such as all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are free to use on free-tier clusters, with no token charge; larger models (mxbai, SPLADE) run on metered tokens with a monthly free allowance of up to 5 million tokens per model on paid clusters only. No rerank model is listed
free_tier.notes: unverified: no request or token cap for the free models appears on the pages read; the Inference tab of a cluster in the console lists the current models, which the page reader could not open

tooling: the Qdrant client sends text or images in the upsert and query calls and the cluster embeds them; external providers (OpenAI, Cohere, Jina AI, OpenRouter) are accepted with the caller's own key
chaining: embedding and search in one call on the same free cluster; the free tier is the cluster of 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk

limits.value: unverified: no rate or token limit for the free models is published on the pages read

identity_cost.detail: the log-in page offers an email address, Continue with Google or Continue with GitHub; unverified: whether the sign-up asks for a card

confidence_note: the free-model statement, the paid-only 5M token allowance and the region note are quoted from the vendor page; the free models' limits and the sign-up card question are unverified.

evidence.quote: Start at no cost: BM25 and a dense model like all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are free to use, including on free-tier clusters.
evidence.proved: BM25 and the dense all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model are free, including on free-tier clusters

evidence.quote: Free models carry no token charges, and paid Qdrant Cloud users receive a monthly free allowance of up to 5 million tokens per model.
evidence.proved: free models carry no token charges; the 5 million token monthly allowance is for paid clusters

evidence.quote: Inference runs in the EU for clusters in EU regions and in the US for clusters in all other regions. Free models are hosted in the US region but can be called from any region.
evidence.proved: the free models run in the US region and can be called from any region
the Qdrant Cloud log-in page offers an email, Google or GitHub sign-in

binding_note: no limit on the free models is published; the free cluster's own 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk bound what can be stored
